atmosphere.qualification: Assumed ICAO-like sea-level atmosphere because the publication does not report calculation conditions.

parameters.uncertaintyQualification: The publication rounds velocity to whole metres per second and reports no measurement or calculation uncertainty. The 1 m/s value is a fitting weight and is not a claimed source standard deviation.
assumptions: The published V1 value of 455 m/s supplies the launch velocity and is excluded from the fitted observations.
The single 33 m value exactly determines one constant coefficient and leaves zero residual degrees of freedom.
The fit must report insufficient_information, no confidence interval, and no validation claim.

method.objective: Minimize the sum of squared velocity residuals divided by the declared fitting-weight variance using calibration-role observations only.
